verdict.rationale: Yapily's account consent token covers accounts and balances (yapily-docs-27) and transactions (yapily-docs-28, yapily-docs-2), so one AIS authorisation serves several data endpoints. The evidence never shows identity or ownership confirmation (yapily-docs-4) running off that same consent, and payments use their own authorisation flows (yapily-docs-29). Missing for 10: explicit documentation that one session spans identity/verification alongside data, a stated multi-product single-consent model, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
